facts.fact: Freedom House says journalists in The Gambia continued to face arrests and be fined for their online commentary during the coverage period, though no prison sentences were reported.

GMB.note: The score of 60/100 places nothing; the March 2026 arrest cited was for common assault, which is not speech; draft PURA content rules are an unused power to order removal.
